opening.argument: The walkthrough presents BitClub Network as a way to receive Bitcoin through member commissions and tiered team structures. The speaker states, “Today is the first day of receiving Bitcoins from BIT.club Network,” identifies a green control to “request commission click on it,” and instructs viewers to “enter the bitcoin address” while also entering account information. The account materials describe commissions paid through a Binary Tree and Level-Up Bonus, with received commissions attributed to members for being in Team 1 or Team 2. These features promote participation in a recruitment-based commission structure and provide a procedure for requesting payment. The evidence does not establish that the displayed balance was genuine or that any transfer completed.
